title: Restore Linux E2EE vault access for ordinary MCP stdio hosts.
changes: Recover only the current owner’s private Linux session bus when an MCP host omits D-Bus environment variables. Verify private directory and socket ownership; never fall back to plaintext key storage.
Preserve native X11 capture and reliable WebRTC lifecycle from 0.2.260–0.2.261. Verify encrypted read grants and immediate control-to-read downgrade rejection.
